# FG-INT-0026

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 502 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`oidc-login`](../../ops/runbooks/oidc-login.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_refused_registry_keeps_the_previous_copy` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 組織の台帳の読み取りが拒否されました。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: Reading the organisation master was refused. Contact the administrator.
- id: Pembacaan data induk organisasi ditolak. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

The PFS registry-api refused the gitstation client's client-credentials token on `GET /api/v1/org/units` or `/api/v1/org/positions` (`status` 401, 403 or 404; ADR-0038 §8): PFS does not list `gitstation` in `ORG_READER_CLIENTS`, the token is for another realm or client, or the registry does not have the org routes yet (404). 401 / 403 also drop the cached token. The previous copy stays unchanged; the task retries with its backoff. Waiting does not fix it.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event `forge.org.master_sync_failed` with `reason=refused`, `status` and `list`. The token itself is never logged. `forge doctor` row `org.master` turns stale after `org.master_max_age_hours`.

## 対処 (fix)

Runbook oidc-login, 「組織の台帳の写し」: ask the PFS operators to set `ORG_READER_CLIENTS=gitstation` on registry-api (their MR !28) and check that `auth.oidc.client_id` is the gitstation client of realm iotpf. No GitStation change is needed; the next run picks it up.
